description: Claude Code hook-group manifest consumed by invoke_dispatch_claude.py (one process per (event, matcher) group) and expanded by build/scripts/generate_hooks_events.py back to per-hook entries so the generated Copilot tree is unchanged. file is relative to .claude/hooks/. timeout/statusMessage preserve the pre-consolidation per-hook registration values for generator fidelity. copilotMatcher overrides the group matcher for Copilot shim generation only. copilotExclude must be a strict boolean; when true it omits the shim from Copilot expansion entirely and requires the group to declare surface: plugin, plus non-empty copilotExcludeIssue and copilotExcludeDecision metadata naming the authorizing issue and the ADR that owns the security judgment (ADR-085 Decision 7, generic field governance, issue #5013). invoke_dispatch_claude.py ignores copilotExclude* fields entirely, so Claude Code keeps running the shim unchanged.
